thesis.hypothesis: The economic hypothesis is exactly that of the attempt-2 packet (digest 617988282ad6dfbf0ee7188f002676a1675dfac38c9ac969071bee3091b2e770): a matched BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT spot-long / USD-M perpetual-short carry with fixed monthly equal-quantity targets (gross 0.5, common lot 0.001, irreversible 10% drawdown stop), executed only against later recorded depth under the declared fees and adverse-price assumptions, earns positive net virtual-USDT profit above recorded fees over a fresh ninety-day window, positive in each of three thirty-day blocks, with nonzero funding receipts in every block, while staying flat at the terminal close. Attempt 3 changes no economic parameter and no economic acceptance criterion. Any reused 2023-2024 development replay of the same fixed family is reused-development evidence only and is not evidence for the prospective window; no development economic outcome is recorded in this packet.
thesis.economic_mechanism: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet and the implementation packet: when the perpetual funding rate is positive, long perpetual holders pay short holders at each published settlement (00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC); a spot-long / perpetual-short pair of equal quantity hedges price exposure and collects the transfer, net of two-venue taker fees, depth-limited adverse fills and basis or hedge-break risk. The decision chain (source, availability, feature_state, model_strategy, intent, order, fill, accounting, evidence, decision) is the attempt-2 chain. This packet adds evidence-boundary software only: a screen version that accepts a failed capture or a skipped slot only when it is registered, of a registered class and inside the budgets; an audit that re-derives the skipped slots from the cycle roster; a lineage version that names the preceding attempt; and a report of the skip count and its distribution relative to the 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC funding settlements. No economic parameter, criterion, cost, window or symbol changes. No attempt-1 or attempt-2 timing, price, equity or outcome figure was read or used.
thesis.counter_hypothesis: A positive paper result, if any, is explained by something other than a repeatable carry edge: every alternative of the attempt-2 packet (selection of the carry family on seen development data, a single ninety-day regime, optimistic fills at 10% of displayed depth with a flat 5bp adverse buffer and no queue or latency, receipt-time-only spot depth, mark-to-mid spot valuation, funding-rate compression, or an operational artifact), plus the following attempt-3 specific alternatives. (1) Restart selection: attempt 3 exists because attempt 2 ended; if the restart were conditioned on an observed attempt-2 outcome it would be optional stopping. Mitigation: attempt 2 ended from a software defect found in the failure marker, no attempt-2 outcome is read or used, and the attempt-2 root stays unevaluated. (2) Staler quotes: the reader now accepts a capture that was within five seconds at completion and consumed up to ten seconds later, so a venue-stamped mark can be fifteen seconds old at valuation; the flat 5bp adverse buffer is not calibrated to that age, so staler fills may be systematically favourable or unfavourable. (3) Skip selection: slots skipped by the collection policy may coincide with fast or illiquid markets, so the retained observation set may be biased toward calm periods; retries accept a later capture in place of a failed one. The skip budget bounds but does not remove this. (4) Post-hoc tolerance fitting: tolerances could be tuned until a capture succeeds; they are therefore bound to the source constants by a test and may not change after a seal. Implementation-specific alternatives. (5) Reading selection: the pre-registration left implicit whether a transient rules-refresh failure inside the one-hour hold is retried or consumes a budget; the implementation takes the conservative reading (no retry, no budget, proceed on the held rules, a Class D or Class I refresh failure ends the attempt) and states it, so a more tolerant reading could not be chosen after a failure; decisions may run on rules up to one hour old, which is accepted in the G3 boundary. (6) Unregistered skips: a slot that never ran, or a failed capture directory without a registry row, could pass as healthy; both are registered or the cycle stays unacknowledged and the collector halts on reopen. (7) A failed execution capture lets its pending decision expire through the existing permanent data-gap cancellation, so the skip budget does not rescue that case; this is not tuned away. Seal-candidate specific alternatives. (8) Audit leniency: accepting registered failures could let an unregistered failure, an unregistered skip, an unconsumed capture, an over-budget run or a terminal marker pass as healthy. The audit therefore requires every failed or unused capture directory to be a registered row whose outcome matches its evidence, every cycle without a command to own a registered skip of its own slot, re-derives the skipped slots from the cycle roster instead of trusting the skips table, applies the three budgets to the union, bounds the failed captures of one slot, and leaves every other screen v2 rejection and every failure marker rejecting; screen v3 and screen v2 audit a root without skipped slots identically. (9) Selection by report: the skip report is descriptive and enters no criterion, so it cannot be tuned to qualify; it exists so that no claim can extend beyond the retained slots. (10) Lineage laundering: lineage v4 could hide an unreported earlier attempt or a predecessor that was not invalid; it names attempt 2 only, records a software-defect cause and no economic field, requires the predecessor root to match the recorded identity and to hold the permanent failure marker on every collector entry, and leaves the absence of an unreported earlier attempt to the result-blind G0 review of the preserved root. (11) Seal reuse: the attempt-2 or attempt-1 protocol digest could be sealed again; the evaluator rejects an equal digest and the lineage records that the seal is not reused.
thesis.information_gain: Building the screen v3, the evaluator audit and the lineage before any attempt-3 data exists means an INVALID outcome and a retained-slot set are classified by ex-ante, tested rules rather than post hoc, and a valid ninety-day window can falsify the economic hypothesis exactly as in the attempt-2 packet. A rejected frozen screen is a valid failed-hypothesis outcome. A pass shows only that this one window met the frozen criteria under paper assumptions, for the retained slots.

thesis.stop_rule: Do not seal, launch, run the storage probe or touch the network under this packet. A seal needs all of: (a) a fresh result-blind review of this packet's exact digest and heads that finds no blocking issue, through the extended same-account receipt route of Issue #810 comment 6715501420 (operator-enforced, not different-principal independence, no PASS claimed); (b) the result-blind G0 resolution of the preserved attempt-2 root with the v1 reader (the predecessor-root-unavailable exception of https://github.com/shuntatsu/trade_rl/issues/810#issuecomment-6680576996 does not extend to attempt 3, and lineage v4 admits only an available root); (c) a fresh storage probe with its own authorization comment; (d) explicit owner authorization on Issue #810 naming the UTC start, the run root and the launch commit; (e) a frozen checkout of a launch commit whose packet-bound code equals this packet's implementation_head. After a later authorized seal, an INVALID event (any permanent failure marker, a Class D or Class I failure, a skip budget breach, an unregistered failure or skip, an observation gap over 180 seconds, changed source or runtime identity, clock reversal, an unmatched hedge, drawdown at or above 10%, or a late, missing, revised or out-of-order funding settlement) ends the attempt: no resume, repair or backfill. A failed screen is not rescued by changing criteria, window, symbols, costs, participation, stop level, tolerances or budgets. If attempt 3 is INVALID or rejected, a further attempt needs a new lineage, a new packet, a new review and a new seal, and the carry line stops if the economic screen itself is rejected.
thesis.metric_proxy_rationale: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: net marked virtual-USDT equity change against the declared zero-interest cash comparison on the canonical ledger, with once-charged fees, depth-based adverse fills, funding by published settlement time and actual simulated exits, requiring positive net profit, positive return in each thirty-day block, net profit above recorded fees, observed maximum drawdown below 10% and funding receipts in every block. It is a paper proxy; minute sampling is not an intraminute drawdown or liquidity guarantee.
